notes.title: Demo v1.0.12 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey Squad,[/p][p][/p][p]Today's update contains a change to how we handle lobbies to avoid a rare issue we've been seeing that can result in 5 players entering the same lobby - which breaks the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed rare issue allowing more than 4 players to join the same lobby[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.11 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey Squad,[/p][p][/p][p]Small update today that fixes a handful of bugs caused by players joining lobbies from different machines but using the same steam account. Unfortunately, this is not supported as steam only allows players to be logged in from one device.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed players not leaving the lobby when signing out from steam.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.10 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey Squad,[/p][p][/p][p]Another round of bug fixes this week, as well as a change in the way we find open squads so that AFK people hosting a squad don't inadvertently block other players from finding an active squad.[/p][p]Thank you again for all the bug reports and feedback![/p][p][/p][h3]Feature Changes[/h3][list][*][p]When finding open squads, try and avoid entering the same lobby repeatedly if multiple are available.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issue with music not playing when you start the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with animation events sometimes playing on dead enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue that can occur when waiting for players after picking an upgrade card.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.9 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey Squad,[/p][p][/p][p]A few more bug fixes in this patch, as well as some additional reporting. We know a few of you have been having some disconnection issues occasionally, and this reporting will hopefully help us understand what's happening there. Thanks again for playing![/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed null reference related to settings screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a navigation edge case that could cause performance spikes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player sometimes getting stuck on environmental objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues during game shutdown when returning to lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved reporting of errors.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.8 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey Squad,[/p][p][/p][p]Just a handful of bug fixes in this patch.  Happy shooting![/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed rare issue that can occur when changing traits just as the game starts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue when trying to show an unbound control in-game.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional logs and checks to try and narrow down a rare, hard to reproduce issue.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.7 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey Squad,[/p][p][/p][p]It's so great to see lots of you playing the demo, and that more and more people are discovering the game every day! Thank you all for playing and spreading the word![/p][p][/p][p]This patch aims to fix various issues that have been popping up over the last couple of weeks - thank you for sending in your bug reports, they've been very helpful![/p][p][/p][p]We've also taken the opportunity to add support for controls customization, which is something some of you have asked for. You can find this in the 'Controls' section of the 'Settings' menu.[/p][p][/p][p]Please continue to let us know if you encounter any issues - and once again, thank you all for playing![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Feature Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Controls customization - The controls for keyboard/mouse and gamepad can now be customized in the Settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved behaviour when swapping between keyboard/mouse and controller.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed very rare issue related to the amount of data being sent after a connection drops temporarily[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed jerkiness on remote clients during slow motion[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues when closing the game via Alt+F4 or Task Manager[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare issue on disconnect when leaving the lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue causing remote clients to try to change values on accessibility sliders when they shouldn't[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential cause of stutter for a number of players[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.content: [p]Hey squad,[/p][p][/p][p]First of all, a massive thank you to all the people that have played our demo so far. The response to the game has been incredible and we're very happy to see so many of you having a lot of fun with it! We've also been receiving a lot of great and constructive feedback, suggestions and ideas. Thanks to everyone that has taken the time to send it in - it's hugely appreciated.[/p][p][/p][p]After going over all the feedback, there were clearly some common themes and criticisms, primarily related to meta progression, traits system and the in-game upgrades. We agree with a lot of this feedback and, whilst we have plans for these areas, we want to take a little more time in order to make sure we address them properly. Unfortunately, that means we're not going to be able to release the game in July.[/p][p][/p][p]We don't expect to take too much longer - just a few extra weeks. Once we have an exact release date, you'll be the first to hear.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and continued support,[/p][p][/p][p]Martin & João[/p][p]Bellyflop Games[/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.6 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Next Fest is now over, but the good news is we're leaving our demo up for people to play![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who gave it a go, we hope you enjoyed it!  The feedback has been very positive and constructive overall!  So thank you for writing up your comments, thoughts, ideas and even those pesky bugs.  We'll now be collating it all, going through it and using it to help guide the game's direction and focus going forward.  Note that we're happy to receive feedback any time, so don't hesitate to send it in.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed shielded enemy VFX getting stuck sometimes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies sometimes getting stuck in a bad state when the player they were targeting disconnects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue related to coin processing[/p][/*][*][p]Speculative fix for a rare issue leaving the game in a bad state[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.5 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Some more changes and fixes for the demo.[/p][p][/p][h3]Feature Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Improved bullet vs metal spark VFX[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issue with error handling when trying to host or join a squad without steam running[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues caused by players disconnecting during the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue when returning to lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with some UI elements sometimes getting stuck on screen after card selection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with shielded enemy charge effect when leaving the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Good luck against the horde![/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.4 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]We've fixed some issues that have been found:[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed remote players sometimes being able to heal without having a medpack[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed accessibility sliders showing default values when returning to the lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies sometimes walking under ground or on air[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Good luck against the horde![/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.3 - Accessibility Patch
notes.content: [p]Hi,[/p][p][/p][p]First things first, a big thank you once again to everybody who has been playing our demo and giving us feedback. It's been really helpful to hear what different players are enjoying and not enjoying. It's all valuable feedback, so thank you for taking the time to write it.[/p][p][/p][p]We're going to go through all the feedback after Next Fest is over to help figure out what needs to change and the direction to go in as we head towards the full release of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]However, one thing that has stood out in particular is that most people find the horde too hard to beat. We did want the game to be challenging so that it was something people could come back to, practice, and ultimately beat - but it seems we overshot the mark.[/p][p][/p][p]We've decided to address that with a couple things:[/p][list][*][p]We have tweaked the medpack drops so that you get slightly more on average and, crucially, ensure a minimum amount each game.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added accessibility sliders in the lobby, which the host can set, for:[/p][list][*][p]Horde Size (50% to 150%) - decrease or increase the amount of enemies spawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Horde Health (50% to 150%) - decrease or increase the amount of health enemies have.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]We encourage players to try the game without modifiers but now you can make the game easier (or harder!) to your liking. Hopefully you can find a level of challenge that suits you. If you do, we'd love to know what values were right for you as it'll help us tweak the balance for the full game. You can leave a comment on this post or reach out to us in any of the other feedback channels - steam discussions, discord, google forms, etc.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing, and good luck![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Feature Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted medpack drop frequencies and ensured minimum number of medpacks per game[/p][/*][*][p]Added 'Horde Size' and 'Horde Health' accessibility sliders in the lobby[/p][/*][*][p]New graphical cursors for UI and gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI animations in card selection screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added music to frontend[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual notification when new content has been unlocked[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed medpacks spawning at the center of the map for remote players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some UI issues when collecting multiple crates at the same time[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.2 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Another big thank you to everyone playing the demo!  We're happy that you're all enjoying it and would like to thank you for all the feedback we've received so far![/p][p][/p][p]We've fixed some more issues, mainly related to gamepad input:[/p][p][/p][h3]Feature Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Added warning messages on trait selection when slots are full or locked[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed weapon list scrolling with controller[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed trait selection with controller[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed trait details not updating with controller[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with sound manager when returning to the lobby[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Good luck against the horde![/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Thanks to everyone who has played the Steam Next Fest demo!  We hope you've been having fun and been able to survive the horde![/p][p][/p][p]We've made a number of improvements and fixes to address some issues that have been found.[/p][p][/p][h3]Feature Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted spawning behaviour for some enemy types[/p][/*][*][p]Save player loadout when quitting the lobby without playing (was previously only saved when starting a game)[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent quitting the lobby during game start up[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Improved error handling during connection to host[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue leaving hosts in a bad state after a player disconnects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue during player initialization when either the player or their host disconnects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed revive circle staying permanently on when a dead player disconnects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed players completing grenade throws after being killed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect death pose when dying during sprint or grenade throw[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to close non-interactive modal screens[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed revive icon showing when it shouldn't[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with UI animations when leaving a game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing and for sending us all the feedback, comments and bug reports![/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Available Now!
notes.content: [h2]Our Next Fest demo is here![/h2][p]This is a new and improved demo with more of almost everything - More maps to survive, more weapons to master, more difficulties to conquer, and an entirely new mechanic to play with! It's also had a whole array of polish, juice and love applied across the board.  So if you played the Beta Test demo, it will be worth jumping in again to try and beat the horde once more![/p][p][/p][p]While this demo is still just a small sample of the full game, it features:[/p][list][*][p]2 difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]3 maps[/p][/*][*][p]8 weapons[/p][/*][*][p]12 character traits[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Character Traits[/h2][p]We're introducing traits which affect your character in a variety of ways, usually under specific conditions, requiring you to adapt and change how you play. They represent both strengths and flaws, and you must take the good with the bad.[/p][p]In this demo, you will have 4 unlockable trait slots and a sample of 12 traits to choose from, already unlocked for convenience. In the full game, the traits must also be unlocked by meeting specific requirements. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545014/d6743e809f3c93fdebf0a96f2d47070ba478de85.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Patch notes[/h2][p][/p][h3]Feature Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Gameplay[/p][list][*][p]Added Character Traits[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Adjusted navigation priorities to improve how faster enemies traverse through dense groups of enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted colliders on dismembered limbs to prevent them rolling for too long[/p][/*][*][p]Added a revive progress indicator[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked some enemy AI and refactored their melee attack system[/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 map layouts[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hit detection on remote clients[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Graphical improvements[/p][list][*][p]Added emissive glows on explosions, bullets, weapons and more[/p][/*][*][p]New VFX for player down[/p][/*][*][p]Improved supply crate VFX[/p][/*][*][p]Improved medpack VFX and added animations for spawn and pickup[/p][/*][*][p]Improved VFX on enemy hits[/p][/*][*][p]Improved VFX on some enemy attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Added new animations to some enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked bullet graphics[/p][/*][*][p]Improved damage numbers graphics[/p][/*][*][p]Added VFX for player healing[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Audio[/p][list][*][p]Added music during gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]New sound effects across the board, with better balancing and spatial effects.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some wall colliders causing players to get stuck on some corners[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some edge cases in pathfinding causing paths to go through blocked areas[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies sometimes not throwing grenades[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some UI elements in 16:10 resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some UI issues when opening multiple crates at once[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you have fun playing and thank you for trying our demo![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
As some of you have noticed, we have been actively updating the demo over the last few days. These updates have been mainly focused on bug fixing and QoL updates. Here's a full breakdown of what we've been up to:

[h3]Feature Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added in-game controls display to help new players
[*]Downed players in squad games will now automatically spectate other players
[*]Player character now ragdolls on death when playing in Lone Wolf or when they're the last player alive in a squad
[*]Escape/back buttons on keyboard/controller now cancel readiness in lobby or go to previous screen
[*]Launching the game from a friend invite now joins directly into lobby
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed crash caused by a memory allocation issue
[*]Fixed possible memory leak when returning to main menu after playing a game
[*]Fixed players getting stuck on card selection screen after other players disconnect
[*]Fixed errors in the card selection system caused by returning to main menu during card selection
[*]Fixed some issues with input behaviour when swapping between controller and mouse/keyboard
[*]Fixed players sometimes not regaining control of their character after exiting the card selection screen
[*]Fixed players sometimes getting stuck on the escape menu
[*]Fixed error when trying to update stats for a player that had disconnected
[*]Fixed ragdoll joints causing glitching/stretching/spinning ragdolls
[*]Fixed issue caused by the host disconnecting during startup
[*]Fixed players sometimes getting stuck running without control after being revived
[*]Fixed issue with timeout mechanism when trying to connect to the host
[*]Fixed a controller issue when leaving the card selection screen requiring players to release the trigger before being able to fire again
[*]Fixed some UI elements being cut off in 16:10 resolutions
[/list]


Thank you all for trying our demo and sending us your bugs and feedback!
